projects.name: MassDOT Highway and CIP Projects (Projects_Flat, lines)
projects.notes: All MassDOT Highway Division projects plus Capital Investment Plan projects, any stage. Status separates planned from built (see values); DesignStatus gives the design stage and constructionStatus the construction stage; ScheduledAdDate is the scheduled advertising date, bidOpenedDate / ntpDate bid and notice-to-proceed; TFPCC is total federal participating construction cost (string); extendedDescription is a longer narrative; More_Info links to the MassDOT project page. Location is the town name (no county field; MPO is the regional planning area). Layer 4 (CIP Point Projects) and 6 (cipPolygons) hold non-linear CIP projects.

projects.name: MassDOT TIP Projects (lines)
projects.notes: Subset of highway projects programmed in the regional TIPs/STIP. Same schema. Status separates planned from built (see values); DesignStatus gives the design stage and constructionStatus the construction stage; ScheduledAdDate is the scheduled advertising date, bidOpenedDate / ntpDate bid and notice-to-proceed; TFPCC is total federal participating construction cost (string); extendedDescription is a longer narrative; More_Info links to the MassDOT project page. Location is the town name (no county field; MPO is the regional planning area).

parcels_statewide.name: Massachusetts Property Tax Parcels (MassGIS Level 3 parcels with assessor data)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: Item terms only say assessor parcel mapping is a representation, not an authoritative boundary source; no commercial-use or solicitation restriction stated.
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide (all 351 municipalities) with owner name and mailing address. No county field: CITY is the municipality name and TOWN_ID the MassGIS town number. MAP_PAR_ID / PROP_ID are the assessor's local ids, LOC_ID the statewide polygon id. LOT_SIZE units are given in LOT_UNITS (Acres or square feet). FY is the assessment fiscal year and varies by town. Includes USE_CODE, LS_DATE/LS_PRICE (last sale).

summary: MassDOT Highway/CIP and TIP project line layers verify with status and scheduled advertising date, and MassGIS statewide parcels include owner name and mailing address.
